scope: Automated engine checks, not human playtests.

records.name: Seed reproducibility and input immutability
Invalid seeds rejected
Paired arrival packets are always together
Boat capacity includes Achilles two seats
Cannot depart empty or return loaded
Boarding and unboarding preserve waiting deadline
Exact zero light survives; excess fog fails before arrival
Known lethal crossings need explicit confirmation
Back does not consume a memory or advance time
Killer drain cannot be prevented by fog protection
Light memory happens before Killer drain and fog, with cap
Soldier conflict counted once per pair
Waiting deadline advances per move; new Wraith tax begins next move
Calm memory postpones one deadline, without shielding fog
Calm requires a waiting target and other memories reject targets
Tainted passenger may deliver on second move before Ship Wraith check
Tainted passenger left aboard after second delivery becomes Wraith
Normal passenger expires only after third arrival delivery
Haven advances clocks, delivers nobody and can create Ship Wraith
Haven cannot rescue a lethal approach
Multiple matched souls grant only one light per landing
Quest passage gives only a wish and consumes token once
Sanctuary matches all wishes but grants no light or memories; retires once
Unmatched souls deliver safely without rewards
Po Din grants wish and landing light but no memory
Duplicate delivery and replaying delivery are rejected
Memory overflow requires player choice and cards are permanently spent
Return has pressure and Wraith fog, no recovery, and advances waiting
First-move events modify only their advertised part of fog
Narrow Channel limits seats to three
Return on final trip decides ending only after surviving cost
Save round trip retains pending move and rejects tampered forecasts
Save rejects duplicate souls, excess hand, wrong version, oversized input
Empty shore and supply end after a survived return
Passage on the final waiting soul cannot strand an empty boarding phase
Printed example matches payment, deadline, rewards and return
200 seeded legal random nights terminate with validated invariants
